blocks.prompt: 12 If between any two numbers there are inserted two A.Ms. \(A_1, A_2\), two G.Ms. \(G_1, G_2\) and two H.Ms. \(H_1, H_2\); show that \(\frac{A_1 + A_2}{G_1 G_2} = \frac{H_1 + H_2}{H_1 H_2}\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh proof teeno means (A.M., G.M., H.M.) ko ek saath jorta hai. Do numbers ko \(a\) aur \(b\) maan lein.
Ek pyaari property kaam aayegi: chaar terms ki A.P. mein beech wali do terms ka jama kinaron ke jame ke barabar hota hai, aur G.P. mein beech wali do ka product kinaron ke product ke barabar.
Plan: dikhana hai ke dono sides \(\frac{a + b}{ab}\) ke barabar hain.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(a, A_1, A_2, b\) A.P. mein; \(a, G_1, G_2, b\) G.P. mein; \(a, H_1, H_2, b\) H.P. mein (\(a, b\) positive).
Saabit karna hai: \(\frac{A_1 + A_2}{G_1 G_2} = \frac{H_1 + H_2}{H_1 H_2}\).
Tareeqa: A.P. aur G.P. ki "barabar faasle wali terms" ki property, aur H.P. ke liye us ke reciprocals ki A.P.

A.M.s ka jama
\[A_1 = a + d, \quad A_2 = b - d\]
\[A_1 + A_2 = a + b\]
Kyun: \(A_1\) pehli term \(a\) se ek qadam aage hai, aur \(A_2\) aakhri term \(b\) se ek qadam peeche. Jorne par \(+d\) aur \(-d\) kat jate hain. Misaal: 1, 4, 7, 10 mein \(4 + 7 = 11 = 1 + 10\).

G.M.s ka product
\[G_1 = ar, \quad G_2 = \dfrac{b}{r}\]
\[G_1 G_2 = ab\]
Kyun: G.P. mein qadam multiply wala hota hai. \(G_1\) ek qadam aage (\(\times r\)), \(G_2\) aakhri se ek qadam peeche (\(\div r\)). Multiply karne par \(r\) kat jata hai. Misaal: 1, 2, 4, 8 mein \(2 \times 4 = 8 = 1 \times 8\).

To left side yeh bani
\[\dfrac{A_1 + A_2}{G_1 G_2} = \dfrac{a + b}{ab}\]
Kyun: Upar \(a + b\) aur neeche \(ab\) rakh diya. Dekhiye, \(d\) aur \(r\) ki values humein maloom hi nahi karni pareen; property ne seedha jama aur product de diya. Ab sirf yeh dikhana baqi hai ke right side bhi isi fraction ke barabar hai.

H.M.s ke liye reciprocals ki A.P.
\[\dfrac{1}{a}, \; \dfrac{1}{H_1}, \; \dfrac{1}{H_2}, \; \dfrac{1}{b} \text{ A.P. mein}\]
\[\dfrac{1}{H_1} + \dfrac{1}{H_2} = \dfrac{1}{a} + \dfrac{1}{b}\]
Kyun: H.P. ke reciprocals A.P. hote hain, aur A.P. wali wahi property: beech ki do terms ka jama = kinaron ka jama.
Dhyan dein: \(H_1 + H_2 = a + b\) likh dena ghalat hai; property reciprocals par lagti hai, H.M.s par seedhi nahi.

Dono taraf ek fraction banayein
\[\dfrac{H_1 + H_2}{H_1 H_2} = \dfrac{a + b}{ab}\]
Kyun: \(\frac{1}{H_1} + \frac{1}{H_2}\) ka common denominator \(H_1 H_2\) hai, to \(\frac{H_2 + H_1}{H_1 H_2}\). Isi tarah \(\frac{1}{a} + \frac{1}{b} = \frac{b + a}{ab}\).

Nateeja
\[\dfrac{A_1 + A_2}{G_1 G_2} = \dfrac{a + b}{ab} = \dfrac{H_1 + H_2}{H_1 H_2}\]
Kyun: Do cheezein ek hi teesri cheez ke barabar hon to aapas mein bhi barabar hoti hain. Proof mein yeh "dono sides ko ek common cheez tak le jao" wala tareeqa bahut kaam aata hai.
Tasdeeq: \(a = 1, b = 8\) lein. A.P. 1, 3, 6, 8 se \(A_1 + A_2 = 9\); G.P. 1, 2, 4, 8 se \(G_1 G_2 = 8\); aur \(\frac{1}{H_1} + \frac{1}{H_2} = 1 + \frac{1}{8} = \frac{9}{8}\). Dono sides \(\frac{9}{8}\) \(\checkmark\).
blocks.final_answer: Saabit ho gaya: \(\frac{A_1 + A_2}{G_1 G_2} = \frac{H_1 + H_2}{H_1 H_2}\) (dono \(\frac{a + b}{ab}\) ke barabar).
